note: This file is a pure Python-style configuration file for MMDetection's RTMDet instance segmentation (tiny variant). It contains no callable functions, classes, or methods — only variable assignments, model config mutations, and a training pipeline definition. No CLI-invocable code is present.
review_rtmdet_ins_tiny_config: review the RTMDet instance segmentation tiny model config for backbone, neck, and bbox_head settings
summarize_train_pipeline: summarize the training data augmentation pipeline including CachedMosaic, RandomResize, RandomCrop, and CachedMixUp transforms
review_model_update: review the model.update call that sets deepen_factor, widen_factor, and pretrained checkpoint for the CSPNeXt tiny backbone
summarize_checkpoint: summarize the pretrained checkpoint URL used for initializing the CSPNeXt tiny backbone on ImageNet
review_train_dataloader: review the train_dataloader update that applies the custom train_pipeline to the dataset
